failure_reasons.question: Does the structured encoder generalize to an unseen IC FUNCTION FAMILY (a functional family held out of training), beating BOTH the coefficient-only baseline (at its trained IC) and the naive control by at least delta?
failure_reasons.reason: A positive but sub-delta improvement over the baseline or the naive control on the held-out IC function family.
failure_reasons.judge_reason: Two held-out function families were pre-registered as success axes, and the mean gain is at least delta against both references on each, but seed-noise separation (required for 'clear') is not achieved across them. Polynomials: Reaction Fourier 0.0719+/-0.0178 vs raw 0.0834+/-0.0004; gain 0.0115 is below the pooled SD 0.0126, with one seed reversed. Sinusoids: gain 0.0116 vs raw exceeds the pooled SD 0.0058 and gain 0.0520 vs coefficient. However, the per-query curves do not separate: Reaction Fourier is better on 5/10 queries, raw is better on S0 at all five rates, and the paired 95% CI [-0.0115, 0.0348] includes zero. The task requires separation on each held-out set, with per-specification curves separating. The value is therefore not 'clear'. 'marginal' (positive but short of the clear bar) is the closest tier, although here the shortfall is noise rather than a sub-delta mean.
evidence: Recomputed per-query from per_specification.csv: sinusoid clock better 5/10 (S0 worse at rho=1..5); polynomial 6/10

failure_reasons.question: Are the core generalization margins (over baseline and naive control) statistically separated from seed noise?
failure_reasons.reason: A core margin lies inside the reported seed-uncertainty band -- the claimed win is not separated from noise.
failure_reasons.judge_reason: Margins against raw sensors lie inside the pooled seed-SD band for two core axes: the polynomial unseen-family margin (0.0115 vs 0.0126) and the recombined coefficient x IC pairs (0.0180 vs 0.0237). Coefficient interpolation is also within noise (0.0137 vs 0.0218). Per-query curves do not separate for sinusoids (5/10) or polynomials (6/10). Even the passing sinusoid and joint margins have paired 95% CIs that include zero; only Gaussian interpolation is cleanly separated. The paper reports this honestly, but the core margins are not all noise-separated.
